headline: Costa Rica Assembly Faces Bond Plan and 112 Bills in Special Sessions
summary: Costa Rica's Assembly opened extraordinary legislative sessions featuring 112 bills, including a proposal involving $13.5 billion in bonds.
why: Large sovereign bond authorizations affect national debt profiles, borrowing costs, and fiscal sustainability in emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Costa Rica
impacts.why: Legislative debate over major sovereign debt issuance impacts public finances.
